en: Old Man
Beyond here lies the Cave of Origin, where the spirits of Pokémon are said to rest.
Nobody may go in. Please, turn back.
Steven told me of you. Go on: Wallace is down there, and he has need of you.
Two Pokémon of legend, raging in our harbour... Only someone strong enough to stand before them may enter the cave now.
Steven
Sky Pillar... I've never been there. Where could it be, I wonder?
I think you have just what it takes to help him...
Those Pokémon... Groudon and Kyogre, the two ancient Pokémon, woken from their long sleep...
And now they're hurling all their power at each other, and nothing can stop it.
...{player}. If you're here now, I'll take it you're ready to be part of this.
Then there's someone I'd like you to meet. Come with me, please.
Tell me, {player}. Seeing Groudon and Kyogre, do you think Pokémon are things to be afraid of?
They're not. Pokémon are so much more than that... But why am I asking you? You know that already.
Steven
Here we are. Inside, you'll find a man named Wallace.
I think you have just what it takes to help him...
Two enormous Pokémon are locked in battle. The water heaves and the air crackles round them.
Maxie
G-Groudon... Please, stop! I understand your power now!
If you go on like this, it won't be only Sootopolis. All of Hoenn will be ruined!
Archie
Kyogre! What's wrong? Look here, it's the Red Orb! Calm down! Kyogre!
It's no use. It doesn't hear me at all!
Wallace
{player}... The leaders of Team Magma and Team Aqua didn't mean any harm, I think.
It wouldn't hurt to hear them out.
Kiri
Big, big Pokémon are fighting! I'm scared...
Hello! I'm Kiri. Here, you can have one of these!
And this one too!
When you make a wish, what do you wish for?
Do you like the season you were born in?
Me too! But I love autumn most of all.
Oh. Well, it doesn't really matter.
Woman
The sky was clear this morning... then black clouds rolled in, rain came down in sheets, and the thunder started!
Then it's scorching hot, and then it pours again. Is it all because of those Pokémon?
Woman
Sootopolis grew up inside the crater of a volcano. Look up, and you see the crater's rim all round.
All you see of the sky is a circle. That's why the sky over Sootopolis is the loveliest of all.
When two Pokémon that huge fight that fiercely, there's nothing any of us can do.
Boy
I've never been out of this city. I wonder what the world's like on the other side of the round sky?
Whoa, this is wild!
Boy
Diving in the sea, climbing up and down stairs all day... Live here and you can't help getting fit.
Those giant Pokémon just appeared in the middle of the city! I've never seen them before!
Why are they smashing into each other like that? Why can't they be friends?
Man
You don't look like an ordinary tourist. What brings you all the way into the crater?
Man
Pokémon of legend, right before my eyes! I never thought I'd see them for myself!
Girl
If they keep this up, Sootopolis will be smashed to pieces!
Black Belt
Go, red one! Go, blue one! Hit him harder!
...Hey, do you know those Pokémon's names?
Boy
I don't think those two Pokémon are angry, somehow. I think... they just can't hold their own power back.
The door is shut tight.
The door is shut tight.
